_doc: Session-package catalogue save gating (PackagesSettings: name >= 2, session_count an integer in [1, 200], price in [0, MAX_PRICE]). The [1, 200]/[0, MAX_PRICE] boundaries are the client caps; the DB CHECK constraints they sit inside are packages.session_count > 0 (so the real min is 1) and packages.price >= 0 (migration 20260723120000). meta mirrors those constraints and is pinned against the app constants by e2e/data-driven/consistency.spec.ts. The representative create/list/delete submit lives in e2e/packages.spec.ts.

cases.note: 0 = lower boundary (DB CHECK price >= 0 allows a free package). The negative partition can't be typed, covered by the isNonNegativeNumber invariant.
